records.finding: S10 与 S39 的 PDCSAP 折叠图均显示约 0.4377 天的平滑变化；S39 另有明显单次通量突增。两时段来源图均靠近目标，但分辨不了 5.09 角秒的 Gaia 近邻。S39 SAP 展示的最强单时段候选为约 6.567 天，图中有多次短周期起伏，不能把它当已确认的物理周期。
risks: 5.09445 arcsec Gaia neighbor, G is 1.97116 mag fainter; source not resolved.
42 arcsec ASAS-SN object corresponds to the already saved VSX WISE object, not an additional independent neighbor.
No full period uncertainty or ephemeris established.

records.finding: S6 与 S33 的两种测光产品均可见约 0.05125 天的弱折叠变化，散布较大；来源图集中在目标附近。Gaia 与 SIMBAD 证实 HD 43737B 位于约 6.17 角秒外，G 星等仅差约 0.08，TESS 图不能把这对星分开，暂不把信号归属 A 星。
risks: Unresolved HD 43737 A/B pair: 6.16957 arcsec separation, Delta G=0.080239.
Physical variability type and source component remain unconfirmed.

catalog_source_notes.128580039: Gaia resolves an additional bright source 0.84868 arcsec away with Delta G=0.800518; this target is already excluded from first-discovery consideration by Fetherolf 2023.
